Two trailing spaces end this line.  
So this line starts fresh.
A backslash also forces a break\
and this is the last line of the paragraph.

A soft line break with one trailing space 
renders as a single space.   

> And this one  
> has multiple lines  
> in it.

**Bold text**  
then `code`  
then plain.

Trailing spaces on the final line are not a break.  

```
code keeps its trailing spaces  
verbatim
```
